lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: An exception thrown by an in-process gate escapes runGates and aborts…

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the round-1 WARNING finding: runInProcessGate (scripts/check-all.ts) called gate.run(...) unguarded, so a thrown exception (e.g. checkCoverage/checkSkipRatchet's readFileSync/JSON.parse on a missing/malformed budget or expectations file) escaped runGates's for-loop entirely, skipping every gate scheduled after the thrower and never firing onResults (so --json mode would write no gate-results.json). Fix: wrapped the gate.run(...) call in try/catch, mapping any thrown value (Error or not, coerced via String(err) for non-Error throws) to { passed: false, errors: [message] } -- the same GateResult shape executeGate's other branches already produce on an ordinary failure. Regression coverage added as section 7 of test/check-all-inprocess-gates.test.ts: (a) drives the REAL coverageGate against a cwd deliberately missing scripts/coverage-budget.json (the literal ENOENT repro from the finding), asserting a later 'trailing' gate still runs and onResults still fires with all three gate names present; (b) a synthetic gate whose run fn throws a bare string (not an Error) is still contained with a string-coerced message. scripts/file-size-budget.json's scripts/check-all.ts ceiling raised 365->378 (actual gate-measured line count via content.split('\n').length, not wc -l) with a dated _ref note prepended and staged before the file-size gate was re-run, per the CAM-488 story rubric. Full spine verified green: bun run typecheck (0 errors), bun test (5953 pass / 0 fail), bun run check:all (exit 0, all 14 gates ok). Remaining round-1 finding from prd.json not yet addressed: US-R1-003 (test/check-all.test.ts's file header still claims 'no real subprocess is invoked', which is now false for the three full-manifest tests exercising the real coverage gate's real git diff + real budget/expectations file reads -- restate the header or pass an explicit spawn-only gates array to those three tests). Not in scope for this story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal-harness bugfix (try/catch around an existing internal gate.run() call plus a new node:fs/bun:test regression test using only APIs already used identically elsewhere in the suite); no new external library surface touched.
